screens.name: Welcome & onboarding
screens.description: Three-step product introduction with skip and next actions.

screens.name: Sign in
screens.description: Email and password form with local validation and a demo session.

screens.name: Daily dashboard
screens.description: Personal overview, habit progress and quick navigation.

screens.name: Explore & search
screens.description: Searchable product collection with category filters and an empty state.

screens.name: Product details
screens.description: Product story, selectable finish and add-to-bag action.

screens.name: Shopping bag
screens.description: Editable quantities, totals and an empty-bag state.

screens.name: Checkout review
screens.description: Delivery details, order review and a local order confirmation without payments.

screens.name: Activity & notifications
screens.description: Filterable timeline with unread state and mark-all-read action.

screens.name: Conversation
screens.description: Scrollable conversation with a working local message composer.

screens.name: Book a session
screens.description: Service, day and time selection with a local confirmation.

screens.name: Profile & account
screens.description: Editable name, account overview and navigation to preferences.

screens.name: Preferences
screens.description: Theme mode, local notification preference and reset confirmation.
